features.mask: 1 for observed packet, 0 for structural padding
features.normalization: per-window Known-Train median/IQR, clip to [-4,4], then explicit mask
features.missing_rule: padding is structural and excluded from normalization

model.architecture: two Conv1d blocks: 3->64->128, kernel=3, padding=1; mask-aware BatchNorm; ReLU; masked mean pooling; linear classifier
model.mask_fix: masked positions are zeroed before convolution and excluded from both BatchNorm moments and pooling
model.legacy_boundary: Stage15R T8 used ordinary BatchNorm1d, so its checkpoint is inference-parity checked but formal T8/T16/T32 all use the frozen mask-safe implementation

training.checkpoint_criterion: maximum Known Validation Accuracy; first epoch wins ties

gate.window_bottleneck_confirmed: best of T16/T32 has mean delta Macro-F1 >= 0.015 vs T8, >=4/5 positive protocols, and worst protocol delta >= -0.02
gate.class_conditional_window_benefit: global gate fails, but >=2 preregistered focus class-protocol units gain >=0.05 F1 with net positive rescue and no paired focus class loses >0.05 F1
gate.no_useful_window_benefit: all 15 formal runs complete but neither global nor class-conditional gate passes
gate.insufficient_evidence: any formal run, strict Unknown-Free check, cache parity, legacy T8 inference parity, or protected hash check fails

t64_gate.condition: T32-T16 mean Macro-F1 >=0.01 with >=3/5 positive protocols, and either dataset-level N32 truncation >=0.10 or a focus class has N32 truncation >=0.25 and F1 gain >=0.05
t64_gate.budget_if_entered: same model, seed, optimizer, epochs, batch sizes, checkpoint rule; only window=64 changes
